title: The Product Passport Becomes the House Record
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: A product passport can become part of a house archive when verified compliance data is joined to provenance, care, repair, change, authorship, and stewardship without confusing mandatory fields with complete history.
The ensemble carries material decisions across components; the surviving object cannot narrate every demonstration, correction, and embodied judgment that produced them.

01 · REQUIRE — What is legally required now?. Identify product scope, applicable delegated acts, actor, territory, date, required fields, carrier, access rules, and official legal source. Mark future implementation unresolved until adopted.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · VERIFY — Who supports each field?. Bind claim, data source, responsible party, verification method, date, confidence, correction, and evidence file. Do not transform a supplier assertion into an audited fact.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · EXTEND — What history may responsibly be added?. Connect design development, maker and repair records, care, alterations, provenance, archive deposit, rights, and permitted owner narration while minimizing personal data.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · PRESERVE — Will the record survive the vendor?. Require export, open formats, persistent identifiers, versioning, backups, access governance, migration tests, and a non-digital fallback for essential care information.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
narrativeSequence.rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
